name: Grade 9 IIT Practice: June Week 2 - List Methods
description: Practice words for Grade 9 second-trimester Python and data work.

words.definition: A command that performs an action on data.
words.example: The student used the append method to add a new item to a Python list.
The program added a new survey answer to the end of the list.
The student removed the incorrect item before sorting the data.
The list was sorted so the scores appeared from lowest to highest.
The program displayed each list item on a separate line.

words.definition: A loop that repeats while a condition is true.
words.example: The while loop kept asking for input until the user typed stop.

words.definition: The condition that makes a loop end.
words.example: The word stop became the stopping point for the loop.
